hints: Take logarithms of both sides, expanding the products and powers separately.
Collect the x-terms, solve the resulting linear equation in logarithms, and give x to 3 significant figures.
walkthrough:
Take the natural logarithm of both sides of $3 \times 2^{x+1} = 4 \times 3^{2x-3}$:
$$\ln\left(3 \times 2^{x+1}\right) = \ln\left(4 \times 3^{2x-3}\right)$$

Apply the product and power laws of logarithms $\ln(ab) = \ln a + \ln b$ and $\ln(a^k) = k\ln a$:
$$\ln 3 + \ln\left(2^{x+1}\right) = \ln 4 + \ln\left(3^{2x-3}\right)$$
$$\ln 3 + (x + 1)\ln 2 = \ln 4 + (2x - 3)\ln 3$$

Expand brackets on both sides:
$$\ln 3 + x\ln 2 + \ln 2 = \ln 4 + 2x\ln 3 - 3\ln 3$$

Collect terms containing $x$ on one side and constant terms on the other:
$$\ln 3 + \ln 2 - \ln 4 + 3\ln 3 = 2x\ln 3 - x\ln 2$$
$$4\ln 3 + \ln 2 - 2\ln 2 = x(2\ln 3 - \ln 2)$$
$$4\ln 3 - \ln 2 = x(\ln 9 - \ln 2)$$
$$\ln\left(\dfrac{3^4}{2}\right) = x\ln\left(\dfrac{9}{2}\right) \implies \ln\left(\dfrac{81}{2}\right) = x\ln(4.5)$$
$$\ln(40.5) = x\ln(4.5)$$

Solve for $x$ and evaluate to 3 significant figures:
$$x = \dfrac{\ln(40.5)}{\ln(4.5)} = \dfrac{3.701302}{1.504077} \approx 2.46085 \approx 2.46$$

ai_rubric.Solving Exponential and Logarithmic Equa: Applies a law for the logarithm of a product or power; Derives $\ln3+(x+1)\ln2=\ln4+(2x-3)\ln3$; Concludes with $x=2.46$ (3 s.f.).
